PUSH-1.name: NOT_A_PUSH_NAME
PUSH-1.description: Raised when a push endpoint is registered under a word that cannot name one.

PUSH-2.name: PUSH_NAME_TAKEN
PUSH-2.description: Raised when a push endpoint is registered under a name another holds.

PUSH-3.name: PUSH_NOT_HTTPS
PUSH-3.description: Raised when a push endpoint's address is not an `https` address.

PUSH-4.name: PUSH_KEYS_UNREADABLE
PUSH-4.description: Raised when the keys a push endpoint gave cannot be encrypted to.

PUSH-5.name: PUSH_NOT_REGISTERED
PUSH-5.description: Raised when no push endpoint holds the name asked about.
